purpose: Phase-7C Section 4 CD8 cytotoxic T-cell runtime coefficients. CD8 biology is a STAGED process (priming -> recruitment -> infiltration -> activation -> effector competence -> target engagement -> cytotoxic potential -> dysfunction -> exhaustion -> recovery); a high value at one stage does NOT imply high downstream activity. All weights / thresholds / temporal constants are registry-driven; negative factors (checkpoint / suppression / dysfunction / exhaustion) are applied ONCE through the shared contribution ledger (no duplicate penalties). Prediction-only; schematic normalized [0,1]; no T-cell counts (NOT_REPORTED).

cd4_support_weights.note: Additive, bounded CD4 helper boost applied to CD8 priming and CD8 activation respectively. These are SEPARATE biological relationships (helper support to two distinct CD8 stages) that happen to share a default weight; they are intentionally NOT merged.

capability_weights.note: Weighted mix used to estimate pre-penalty CD8 capability for blocked-potential accounting (capability minus effective cytotoxic). Weights sum to 1.

negative_penalties.penalty_note: Each penalty is applied at exactly ONE stage via a unique contribution id; the double-counting guard rejects re-application of the same causal effect at a later stage.

dysfunction.gradual_rate_note: dysfunction accumulates gradually per frame (bounded), never an immediate irreversible switch.

exhaustion.min_duration_note: exhaustion must not switch on from a single noisy frame; the exhaustion driver must persist this many frames.
exhaustion.driver_persistence_note: SCIENTIFIC_THRESHOLD: the prior-frame exhaustion driver must exceed this (strict >) for exhaustion to be treated as persisted and allowed to rise (distinct from recovery_eligibility_threshold).

recovery.recovery_duration_fallback_note: STRUCTURAL_FALLBACK: placeholder value for the unmodelled recovery-duration input (availability PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE); NOT a calibrated biological coefficient. Replace when a real recovery-duration signal exists.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: every stage score, penalty, and pressure in [0,1]
coefficient_policy.source: general adaptive tumour-immunology biology applied predictively (no direct CD8 dataset for this context)
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: stage weights are schematic; downstream stages are gated by upstream stages, never assumed.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No CD8 count / TCR / clonality / cytokine level (all NOT_REPORTED).
